import ast,base64,json,pathlib,subprocess,zlib
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/qq/work/chain-cell-native-shard-674c72-20261110')
control=pathlib.Path(str(repo)+'-control')
subprocess.run(['bash','scripts/project-preflight.sh'],cwd=repo,check=True)
oldtree=ast.parse((control/'apply-docs.py').read_text())
encoded=[n.args[0].value for n in ast.walk(oldtree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='b64decode' and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Constant)]
assert len(encoded)==1
old=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(encoded[0])))
new=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))
plan=repo/'docs/development/TRNM_AI_NATIVE_BLOCKCHAIN_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md'
doc=repo/'docs/development/specs/pon/CELL_NATIVE_SHARD_RESEARCH_V2.md'
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','06233be630f8eff6cea59cd5111e5941135a4aa5:'+str(plan.relative_to(repo))],cwd=repo).decode()
assert doc.read_text()==old['doc'], 'concurrent contract modification'
assert plan.read_text()==old['prefix']+'\n'+original, 'concurrent plan modification'
doc.write_text(new['doc'])
plan.write_text(new['prefix']+'\n'+original)
print('GROUPED_V3_DESIGN_DOCS_APPLIED',flush=True)
